results.name: TIDAL (SM-05): click-to-load gate names embed.tidal.com + the 30-second/sign-in note and sends nothing before consent; against TIDAL's real bridge: Play → 'Started', Pause → 'Pause sent' (flagged assumed), a start inside the player → 'Started'; spoofed starts (our own window, a foreign pid) ignored

one player at a time (SM-08): a TIDAL video started in Video pauses the TIDAL track playing in Music through TIDAL's real bridge; Music shows 'Pause sent'; Music refuses a video link with a pointer to Video

Qobuz + Amazon Music (SM-06, SM-07): store link → widget.qobuz.com with the page's zone at 390 px with encrypted-media; Amazon Share → Embed code pasted → the issued address minus tracking; a page link → built address + the 'use Share → Embed' note; neither offers controls it cannot honour

library + modal shortcut (SM-08): TIDAL / Qobuz / Amazon links saved show their provider; Next walks them; the Rename dialog traps Escape (closes the dialog only — title unchanged, window open) and Enter renames
